description: This file defines a static class 'ServicesConfiguration' with an extension method 'AddBlazorServices' that registers various services related to catalog lookup, catalog items, and their caching decorators into an IServiceCollection for dependency injection in a Blazor application.

classes.name: ServicesConfiguration
classes.description: A static class providing an extension method to register Blazor-related services into the dependency injection container.

methods.name: AddBlazorServices
methods.description: An extension method for IServiceCollection that registers catalog, item, and caching services with scoped lifetime.
